stem: A cube has edges of 5 cm. Find its surface area.
figure: <svg viewBox="0 0 150 120" width="100%" style="max-width:150px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" role="img" aria-label="A cube with one edge marked 5 cm"><title>A cube with one edge marked 5 cm</title><polygon points="20,40 90,40 90,110 20,110" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><polygon points="20,40 50,14 120,14 90,40" fill="#efeeea" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><polygon points="90,40 120,14 120,84 90,110" fill="#d9d7d0" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="55" y="124" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">5 cm</text></svg>
hint: No triangles here. Count the faces.
working: Not a pyramid: a cube has six square faces. One face: 5 × 5 = 25. Six faces: 6 × 25 = 150 cm².

misconceptions.message: That is the volume, 5 × 5 × 5. Surface area is the faces added up.
That is one face. A cube has six.
That is four faces. Count the top and bottom too.

stem: A tent is a square-based pyramid with base 3 m and slant height 4 m. It is 3.7 m tall at the middle. Canvas covers the four sloping faces only, not the floor. How many m² of canvas is that?

hint: No base. Four triangles, slant height 4.
working: No base this time. Step 2: ½ × 3 × 4 = 6. Step 3: 4 × 6 = 24. Step 5: 24 m². The 3.7 m height is not used.

misconceptions.message: You counted the floor. The canvas covers the sloping faces only.
You used the height of the tent, 3.7. The triangle's height is the slant, 4.
